'''G'haris''' was an object<ref name="FJ" /> located in the [[G'haris system/Legends|eponymous star system]], which was part of the [[Perinn sector/Legends|Perinn sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Region" /> Around [[44 ABY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> G'haris was known for the [[Silk/Legends|silk]] produced by its rare [[saass worm]]s.<ref name="FJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
The object G'haris was first mentioned in the novel ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]'', which was written by [[Christie Golden]]<ref name="FJ" /> and released in [[2011]].<ref name="Amazon">{{RandomHouseOld|url=book/68770/star-wars-fate-of-the-jedi-ascension-by-christie-golden|text=Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi: Ascension}}</ref> Later, the [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|online appendix]] to the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the [[G'haris system/Legends|G'haris star system]] and the planet itself in grid square J-4.<ref name="EAOC" />

==Appearances==
